tooltip_zip_group:
Compression Group:
- Group by Directory: Compress directories and files with the same directory into (directory_name.zip)
- Group by Name: Compress directories and files with the same match name into (match_name.zip)
tooltip_duplicate_algorithm:
Deduplication Algorithm:
- By Name: Perform file deduplication by file name
- Name + Size: Perform file deduplication by file name + size
- File Fingerprint: Perform file deduplication by file fingerprint (files are grouped by size first, then the first/last 1KB of content is compared; approximate check, the whole file is not read)
- File Hash: Perform file deduplication by file MD5 hash
tooltip_delete_filter:
Delete Filter:
- Delete All: Delete all files
- Name Contains: Delete files whose names contain specified string
- Name Not Contains: Delete files whose names do not contain specified string
- Size Less Than: Delete files smaller than specified size
- Size Between: Delete files between specified sizes
- Size Greater Than: Delete files larger than specified size
- Created Before: Delete files created earlier than specified time
- Created Between: Delete files created between specified times
- Created After: Delete files created later than specified time
- Modified Before: Delete files modified earlier than specified time
- Modified Between: Delete files modified between specified times
- Modified After: Delete files modified later than specified time
tooltip_match_method:
Match Method Help:
[Input Match Name]:
- Multiple match names: Can input a single match name or multiple match names separated by '/', or click 'Set' to input multiple match names line by line
- Match name segmentation: Each match name can be split into multiple match fragments by spaces (wildcard and regex modes do not split match fragments)
- Special case: If you want to include spaces in match fragments, you can add quotes at both ends to force the string within quotes to be an indivisible whole

[Select Match Method]:
- Contains Full Name: The searched file or directory name must contain the entire match name
- Contains All Fragments: The searched file or directory name must contain all match name fragments separated by spaces
- Contains Any Fragment: The searched file or directory name must contain any match name fragment separated by spaces
- Equals Name: The searched file or directory name must equal the match name
- Starts with Name: The searched file or directory name must start with the match name
- Ends with Name: The searched file or directory name must end with the match name
- Images (Preset): Match name will be set to '.jpg/.jpeg/.png/.gif/.bmp/.tiff/.webp/.svg/.ico'
- Documents (Preset): Match name will be set to '.xls/.xlsx/.doc/.docx/.ppt/.pptx/.pdf/.csv/.rtf/.odt/.ods/.odp'
- Compressed (Preset): Match name will be set to '.zip/.rar/.7z/.tar/.gz/.bz2/.xz/.iso'
- Text (Preset): Match name will be set to '.txt'
- Exclude Full Names: The searched file or directory name cannot contain any of the match names
- Exclude Wildcards: The searched file or directory name cannot match any of the wildcards
- Matches Wildcard: The searched file or directory name must match the wildcard of match name
- Matches Regex: The searched file or directory name must match the regex of match name
